findings.title: queued default is evaluated once at import time
findings.body: `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` is a dataclass default evaluated when the module is imported, so every AssignmentSource created in the process carries the same stale timestamp rather than the time the assignment was queued. Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: from_dict does not handle the serialized queued value
findings.body: to_dict() serializes `queued` as a datetime object, which is passed through Celery kwargs. Round-tripping through from_dict with a non-JSON-serializable datetime may fail in the task serializer, and from_dict passes whatever `queued` is through unchecked. The task argument is a dict containing a datetime, which is not guaranteed to survive the task broker serialization (e.g. JSON).

findings.title: Inbound deassign path: assignment_source passed but outbound sync on other integrations still fires for the source integration in some paths
findings.body: The deassign path in sync_group_assignee_inbound passes the source integration, but GroupAssignee.deassign only checks the features flag for outbound sync and then calls sync_group_assignee_outbound with assignment_source. Any caller of deassign or assign that does not pass assignment_source (such as the inbound status/other webhook paths) will still cycle back, so the loop protection is only applied to one entry point.

findings.title: Assignment source is not forwarded in the deassign feature check path consistently
findings.body: In deassign, the features.has check is called with actor=acting_user while the source integration is only forwarded to sync_group_assignee_outbound; behavior depends on the flag but there is no test covering deassign with a matching source integration, so the suppression logic for deassign is untested.

findings.title: No test for deassign with a matching source integration
findings.body: The new suppression behavior is tested only for assign. The deassign path, which also takes assignment_source and is the other half of the reported sync loop (unassign propagating back to Jira), has no test confirming outbound unassign is skipped for the originating integration.
